optimize_for_inference_model: optimize a PyTorch model for inference by running conv-BN fusion, dropout removal, and MKL layout optimizations
fuse_model: fuse convolution and batch normalization layers in a PyTorch model for inference
remove_dropout_model: remove all dropout layers from a PyTorch model for inference
gen_mkl_autotuner_inputs: generate an MKL autotuning heuristic by benchmarking subgraphs with example inputs to decide MKL layout usage
test_UnionFind: test the UnionFind disjoint set union data structure for graph coloring and subgraph partitioning
